description: This file defines the ScreenDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for retrieving Screen entities from the database based on module and action URL parameters within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ScreenDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Screen entities, providing methods to query screens based on module and action.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Fetches a Screen entity matching the specified module and action URL, returning null if no match is found.
